description: Governed exemptions from the repository tenant-scope coverage gate (M8.2, AM-7). Each entry waives ONE genuinely cross-scope repository statement. Two classes: (1) DISCOVERY LOAD — a load-by-primary-key that ESTABLISHES the scope for an immediate PDP decision (it cannot filter by an organization it exists to discover); the loaded row's organization is fed to the PDP, which denies cross-organization access before any disclosure, and every subsequent mutation is scope-belted. (2) CROSS-ORGANIZATION READ — a subject reading their own record across organizations, or the relationship-graph capacity resolution that deliberately spans organizations; scoped by subject/actor, not by organization. Every entry names its module, a distinctive SQL substring (sqlIncludes), the class, the reason, the boundary that keeps it safe, and an owner. The gate prints this table on every run and fails on stale entries (no matching statement) — visible debt, not hidden debt.

exemptions.reason: loadAvailabilitySlot: load-by-PK to establish the slot's organization for the booking decision.
exemptions.boundary: PDP decides on the discovered organization; the slot claim (transitionSlotStatusIf) is scope-belted.

exemptions.reason: loadAppointment: load-by-PK to establish the appointment's organization for the access decision.
exemptions.boundary: PDP decides on the discovered organization; all appointment mutations are scope-belted.

exemptions.reason: listPatientAppointments (keyset page): a patient's OWN appointments span organizations (the self-scoped /api/me/appointments read).
exemptions.boundary: Scoped by patient_ref = the authenticated self; the self-access decision governs it, not an organization.
